summary: Backend + frontend test of batch: hourly-revenue API, collapsible side nav, daily report overview (summary + hourly compare chart), period toolbar, Menu two-columns/tabs, tinted Piatti/Clienti cards. Pizzeria Napoli, viewports 1366x900, 1180x820, 820x1180, 390x844. Backend 11/11 pytest pass. Side nav collapse/expand/persist/avatar/rail badge all OK. Daily overview, tooltip, delta pill, menu add/edit/remove, catalog collapse/search, dish deactivate/reactivate, customer archive/restore all work. Found 1 HIGH layout bug (period presets cut off on phone), 1 overlap bug in menu tiles and a few design gaps at tablet widths.

minor.issue: 'annullato' exclusion cannot be exercised: PUT /orders/{id}/status only accepts in_attesa/in_preparazione/pronto/sospeso/consegnato and no 'annullato' order exists in the DB. The filter matches the other report endpoints, so the behavior is consistent, but this was verified only by reading the code.

ui_bugs.issue: The preset chip row overflows off the LEFT edge: '7 giorni' (preset-7days) sits at x=-46 and is partly off screen. There is no horizontal scroll (scrollWidth=390), so the user cannot reach it. The date range button (open-calendar-button) is also not full width (x=56, w=320), but the spec says stacked full width on phone. RCA: rangeDateSelector is flexDirection row + justifyContent flex-end. The presetRow child takes its content width (about 420px > 362), so it overflows to the left. rangeDateSelectorCompact only sets alignItems. Fix: in compact mode use flexDirection 'column' / width '100%' on rangeDateSelector and presetRow, and alignSelf 'stretch' + minWidth 0 on dateRangeButton (or make the presets a horizontal ScrollView).

For dishes with a category, the category badge in menuItemNameRow overflows under the edit/remove buttons. TEST_Pizza_88510a showed 'TEST_Cat_8…' hidden behind menu-item-edit at 1366 collapsed (tile 339px). RCA: menuItemNameRow is a non-wrapping row and menuItemInfo (flex:1) has no minWidth:0, so the badge pushes past the info column. Fix: flexWrap 'wrap' on menuItemNameRow plus minWidth 0 on menuItemInfo (or move the category badge to its own line).

design_issues.screen: Report > Periodo toolbar at 1180x820 (sidebar open) and 820x1180
issues: The toolbar wraps. The switch is alone on row 1, and the presets + date button wrap onto row 2 aligned LEFT (preset-7days x=272 at 1180). This is the user's 'everything is on the left' complaint again at tablet widths. Fix: marginLeft 'auto' / alignSelf flex-end on rangeDateSelector when it wraps, or put the presets in their own right-aligned row. At 1366 it is correct (switch left, presets + date right).

The preset chips (h44, presetRow marginBottom 10) are not vertically centred with the calendar button (h49) or the switch. Their tops align at y=72, but the switch is centred at y=99. Remove the marginBottom on presetRow in wide mode.

design_issues.screen: Report > Giornaliero at 1180x820 with sidebar open and 820x1180
issues: Content width is below 1000 (twoCols false), so daily-summary-card is stretched to the full 900/788px width. Its content only fills about 200px on the left, which leaves a large empty card. The hourly chart is then pushed below. The summary(340)+chart layout would fit side by side from about 760px of content. Consider a lower threshold for DailyOverview 'wide' (for example contentWidth >= 760) than for the sections grid.

The tint is chosen by the category's index in the currently displayed list (catIdx), so it is not stable. TEST_Cat_88510a was blue with the 'Attivi' filter and yellow with 'Tutti'. Tint by a hash of the category id/name, or by the category's position in the full category list, so the colour stays the same per category.
The tab is labelled 'Aggiungi piatti', but the section title is 'Catalogo piatti'. The naming is inconsistent (the spec says 'Catalogo').
Focusing available-search-input shows the browser's default black focus outline inside the rounded pill (visible at 1366). Add outlineStyle 'none' on web.
'Incasso periodo' is cut off as 'Incasso peri…' in report-stat-revenue (the half-width card).

action_items: HIGH: fix the Periodo toolbar on phone. Presets overflow off screen to the left (preset-7days unreachable). Stack the presets and the date button full width in compact mode.
Fix the overlap in the menu tile between the category badge and the edit/remove buttons (menuItemNameRow wrap + minWidth 0).
Right-align the presets + date range when the Periodo toolbar wraps at 1180/820, and vertically centre the preset chips with the calendar button.
Lower the DailyOverview side-by-side threshold so summary + chart sit next to each other at 1180 (sidebar open) and 820 instead of a stretched, mostly empty summary card.
Make the Piatti category tint stable per category, independent of the Attivi/Tutti filter.
Minor: tab label 'Aggiungi piatti' vs 'Catalogo piatti'; web focus outline on the catalog search; truncated 'Incasso periodo' at 390.
Optional code: add a stale-response guard to the hourly-revenue fetch in reports.tsx (line ~204). Quickly clicking prev/next can make an older response overwrite a newer one.
critical_code_review_comments: reports.tsx:204 getHourlyRevenue(selectedDate).then(setHourly) has no request id/abort guard, so it can race when the date changes quickly.

HourlyCompareChart slot hit areas overlap: slot 0 has left=0, width=step, so the second slot covers half of it. Behaviour is acceptable for users (the nearest point wins), but slot 0's visible zone is only step/2. Playwright hover on the slot-11 centre is intercepted by slot-12.
Pre-existing: editing portions above the initial value shows '12/7 porz.' because initialPortions is not updated on edit (menu tile label uses item.initialPortions).
Add-dish modal inputs in menu.tsx (portions/price/notes, 'Aggiungi al Menu' button) and the confirm dialog buttons have no testIDs.
Files are very large: index.tsx 5043, reports.tsx 2314, menu.tsx 2214, dishes.tsx 1320 lines. They should be split.
The DB has many leftover TEST_Cat_* categories and TEST_Piatto_Lungo_* inactive dishes in Pizzeria Napoli from earlier iterations, which clutter the filter chips.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (all flows functional; 1 HIGH + 1 MEDIUM layout bug, several design gaps)
